explanation: The inherited report counts infrastructure failures only inside phase development_walkforward_2019_2023. A data-load failure is intentionally appended with phase infrastructure_failure, so the generated field remains zero even though the append-only trial ledger contains one such entry.
authoritative_accounting_rule: Use the trial ledger for internal engine failures and the append-only research attempt ledger for all Campaign099 failures; do not reinterpret the generated report field as total failures.
